facts.fact: 2026 年，西雅图；她是儿童治疗师，最后一个来访者是丧父（胰腺癌）的九岁男孩
facts.anchor: a nine-year-old boy grieving the loss of his father from pancreatic cancer

facts.fact: 她租在 Queen Anne 区；昨晚 James 把一只金戒指放在她掌心，说「先戴着看看感觉」
facts.anchor: “Just see how it feels,” he said.

facts.fact: James 开一家小法式餐馆，交往两年，仍未同居；她戴着戒指觉得像脚弓上一根刺、像折了一只翅膀的鸟
facts.anchor: the ring he gave me last night feels like a thorn pressing against the arch of my foot

facts.fact: 来电者自报 Helen Ashcroft，主持播客 The Other Grim，正在做一整季盐井岛
facts.anchor: I’m Helen Ashcroft, I host a podcast called The Other Grim.

facts.fact: Helen 问她是不是 2007 年在 Maylarch 外海「encountered」盐井岛的那个 Eleanor Mills
facts.anchor: Is this the Eleanor Mills who encountered Saltwell Island off the coast of Maylarch

facts.fact: Helen 说最近一次目击在缅因外海：一艘邮轮上至少两百人看见，有人拍到视频
facts.anchor: “About the recent sighting? Off the coast of Maine.”

facts.fact: 目击细节：白百叶窗的房子、下方岩上一座玻璃棚（也许是温室）、岸边站着一个男人回头看他们
facts.anchor: a man standing at the shore, looking back at them

facts.fact: 她挂断后上网搜到缅因州 Brunswick 的文章《SALTWELL ISLAND SEEN BY HUNDREDS》，配一张从邮轮甲板拍的照片
她给 Nana 打电话说「岛又出现了」，说可能还能赶上今晚的红眼航班
她脖子上那枚扇贝壳项链是 Nana 在她离家上大学那天给的
facts.anchor: Nana gave me the necklace the day I left for college.

facts.fact: 结尾她决定去新斯科舍——「I’m going home.」
